transcript: Elon Musk just promised to give SpaceX shares to every kid in America. So let's do the math. There are about 72 million kids under 18 in the US. One share each is 72 million shares. SpaceX closed at $146 on Friday, so that's roughly $10.5 billion. That sounds enormous. But Elon owns about 4.8 billion SpaceX shares, so this whole giveaway is around 1.5% of his stake. And it's also a really smart marketing move. 72 million kids means millions of American families with a real stake in Elon's success. When SpaceX wins, their kids win. That buys a lot of goodwill, a lot of belief in him, and a lot of people who want him to keep winning. For about 1.5% of his shares, that's a lot of power. If he actually follows through, this would be one of the first times anyone handed real company ownership to tens of millions of children at once.
caption: Elon Musk just promised to give SpaceX shares to every kid in America
